findings.title: Divergent URL validators between Go and Objective-C
findings.message: Go validation (net/url.Parse) and the native recipe (NSURL URLWithString) use different parsers. A URL that passes Go validation may be rejected natively, or the reverse. The two validators can disagree on edge cases such as IPv6 hosts or percent-encoding, and NSURL may normalize in ways that change the host. This is a security-sensitive check with two non-identical implementations.
findings.suggestion: Treat the native check as authoritative, and add shared test vectors that run through both validators to prove they agree.

finding.title: Native result delivered possibly before registration / duplicate on cancel
finding.message: vellumOpenURL reports a result synchronously from the calling thread for invalid URLs, and vellumCancelOpenURL sends a result for a token even if the operation already completed. Duplicate or early results for a token may race with nativeOperationRun registration, or be delivered twice. After a dispatched open completes, a later cancel emits another result for a stale token.
finding.suggestion: Make result delivery idempotent per token, and have cancel check vellumServiceActive(token) before sending a result. Deliver the invalid-URL result asynchronously or confirm the token is registered before the native call.
